English: Bad news is a problem for both news bearers and news recipients, especially in situations where apprehensions run high given that it may run counter to people’s in situ social and psychological needs (Maynard 2003).
Luganda: Amawulire amabi kizibu eri omuwamawulire n’abo abagafuna, naddala mu mbeera erimu okutya okungi engeri gye kiri nti gasobola okukuubagana n’ebifo awamu n’ebyetaago by’abantu (Maynard 2003).
Yoruba: Ìròyìn aburú jẹ́ ìṣòro fún ẹni tó ń ṣe agbatẹrù ìròyìn àti ẹni tí ó ń gbọ́ ìròyìn, pàápàá jù lọ ní àwọn ipò tó ṣe wí pé ó ṣeéṣe kí ìbẹ̀rù wáyé yìí túmọ̀ sí pé ó lè fa ìṣòro sí àwùjọ ẹ̀dá àti ohun tí a nílò tó jẹ́ ohun ajẹmọ́ ìròrì (Maynard 2003).
Zulu: Izindaba ezimbi ziyinkinga yabo bobabili abaphethe izindaba nabamukeli bezindaba abasha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni lapho uvalo luphakama kakhulu uma kubhekwa ukuthi zingase zingqubuzane nezidingo zabantu zezenhlalo nezengqondo (Maynard 2003).
Hausa: Labarai marasa kyau matsala ce ga masu ba da labarai da masu karɓar labarai, musamman ma wuraren da ake fargabar cewa yana iya cin karo da buƙatun zamantakewa da tunani na mutane (Maynard 2003).
Northern Sotho: Ditaba tša maswabi ke bothata go bobedi batho bao ba tlišago ditaba tše le go bao ba di amogelago, kudukudu ka maemong fao kwešišo ye e hlohlalgo maikutlo kudu fao e lego gore maikutlo a a ka ama dinyakwa tša batho mabapi le tša leago le menagano ya bona (Maynard 2003).
Amharic: መጥፎ ዜና ለዜና አቀባዮችም ሆነ ለዜና ተቀባዮች አስቸገሪ ነው፤ በተለይም ከሰዎች ማህበራዊ እና ስነ-ልቦናዊ ፍላጎቶች ጋር ሊቃረን በመቻሉ ፍርሃት በሚበዛበት ሁኔታ (ሜይናርድ 2003)።

English: The object of this paper was to examine the discursive strategies used by diseased individuals and their caregivers to deliver and manage their bad news.
Luganda: Ekiruubirirwa ky’olupapula luno kwali kwekaliriza lulimi olukozesebwa abantu abalwadde n’abajjanjabi baabwe mu kutuusa n’okufugamu amawulire gaabwe amabi.
Yoruba: Èròńgbà iṣẹ́ yìí ni láti ṣàyẹ̀wò irú ìlànà kíkúrò nínú kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ kan bọ́ sí òmíràn tí àwọn aláìsàn lò àti bí àwọn olùṣètọ́jú wọ́n yóò ṣe pjíṣẹ́ àti ṣàmójútó ìròyìn aburú.
Zulu: Inhloso yaleli phepha bekuwukuhlola amasu anhlalunhlalu asetshenziswa abantu abagulayo kanye nabanakekeli babo ukuletha nokuphatha izindaba zabo ezimbi.
Hausa: Manufar wannan takarda ita ce bincika dabarun tattaunawa da marasa lafiya da masu kula da su suke amfani da su domin isar da kuma sarrafa munanan labaransu.
Northern Sotho: Maikemišetšo a sengwalwa se e bile go lekola mekgwa ye e kwagalago yeo e šomišwago ke batho bao ba hlokofaletšwego le bahlokomedi ba bona go tliša le go laola ditaba tša maswabi.
Amharic: የዚህ ጽሑፍ ዓላማ የታመሙ ግለሰቦች እና ተንከባካቢዎቻቸው መጥፎ ዜናቸውን ለማድረስ እና ለማስተናገድ የሚጠቀሙባቸውን የንግግር ስልቶች መመርመር ነው።

English: In pursing the above objective, transcripts of narratives collected from diseased individuals and their caregivers were subjected to empirical inspection with the view to determining the communicative strategies they employed to deal with their special situation.
Luganda: Mu kukola ku kigendererwa ekyo, obuwandiike bw’emboozi ezaakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva ku bantu abalwadde n’abajjanjabi baabwe bwekalirizibwa n’ekigendererwa eky’okuzuula obukodyo bw’empuliziganya bwe baakozesa okusobola okukwasaganya embeera yaabwe ey’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Nípa títẹ̀lé àfojúsùn òkè yìí, àwọn àkọ́ọ́lẹ̀ tí a gbà láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn àti àwọn olùṣètọ́jú wọn ní wọ́n dábà pé kí wọ́n ṣe àyèwò pẹ̀lú ojú àmúwáyé láti mọ ìlànà ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ tí wọ́n nílò láti mójútọ́ ìṣòro wọ́n.
Zulu: Ekufezekiseni le nhloso engenhla, imibhalo yezindaba ezilandiswayo eqoqwe kubantu abagulayo kanye nabanakekeli babo yahlolwa ngombono wokunquma amasu okuxhumana abawasebenzisile ukubhekana nesimo sabo esikhethekile.
Hausa: Dangane da manufar da ke sama, an duba bayanan da aka tattara daga marasa lafiya da masu kula da su da nufin tantance dabarun sadarwa da suka yi amfani da su dominn tunkarar yanayinsu na musamman.
Northern Sotho: Ka go latela maikemišetšo a ka mo godimo, dingwalollo tša dikanagelo tšeo di kgobokeditšwego go batho bao ba hlokofaletšwego le go bahlokomedi ba bona di ile tša lekodišišwa ka tša mahlale ka maikemišetšo a go tseba mekgwa ya poledišano yeo ba e šomišitšego go rarolla seemo sa bona seo se kgethegilego.
Amharic: ከላይ የተጠቀሰውን ዓላማ ለማስፈጸም ከታመሙ ግለሰቦች እና ተንከባከቢዎቻቸው የተሰበሰቡ የንግግሮች ግልባጮች የተለዩ ሁኔታዎችን ለመቋቋም የተጠቀሙባቸውን የግንኙነት ስልቶች ለመወሰን በማሰብ ነባራዊ ፍተሻ ተደርጎባቸዋል።

English: The study was done within the framework of language and liberty (Obeng 2018, 2020) and the results showed that disease and “powerful” actors intrude on diseased individuals and care-givers’ negative liberty (by encroaching on their fundamental freedoms) and positive liberty (by preventing them from participating in their family and communal lives).
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa n’ennyinyonnyolero y’olulimi n’eddembe (Obeng 2018, 2020) era ebyazuulibwa byalaga nti endwadde n’abantu abalala ab’enkizo bayingirira eddembe ly’abalwadde n’abajjanjabi ery’obutatabangulwa (nga bayingirira eddembe lyabwe eribaweebwa) awamu n’eddembe ly’amaanyi n’ebikozesebwa (nga babalemesa okwetaba mu nsonga za famire zaabwe ssaako ensonga ezeekuusa ku kitundu kyabwe).
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí di ṣíṣe láàárín ìlànà èdè àti òmìnira (Obeng 2018, 2020) àti wí pé èsì náà fi han pé àrùn àwọn alágbárá kó òmìnira àìda ran àwọn aláìsàn àti àwọn olùṣètọ́jú wọn (nípa jíjẹ gàba lé òmìnira wọ́n) àti òmìnira tó da (láti lè má jẹ́ kí wọ́n kópa nínú ètò ẹbí àti ìbánigbé).
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngaphakathi kohlaka lolimi nenkululeko (Obeng 2018, 2020) futhi imiphumela yabonisa ukuthi izifo kanye nababambiqhaza “abanamandla” bagxambukela kubantu abagulayo kanye nenkululeko engeyinhle yabanakekeli (ngokuphazamisa inkululeko yabo eyisisekelo) kanye nenkululeko (ngokubavimbela ukuba babambe iqhaza emindenini yabo nasezimpilweni zomphakathi).
Hausa: An gudanar da binciken ne a cikin tsarin harshe da 'yanci (Obeng 2018, 2020) kuma sakamakon ya nuna cewa cututtuka da wasu abubuwa "masu ƙarfi" suna kutsawa cikin mutane marasa lafiya da masu ba da agajin 'yanci mara kyau (ta hanyar cin zarafi ga 'yancinsu na asali) da kuma 'yanci mai kyau (ta hanyar hanawa). daga shiga cikin danginsu da rayuwar al'umma).
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di dirilwe ka gare ga motheo wa polelo le tokologo (Obeng 2018, 2020) gomme dipoelo di aleditše gore bolwetši le badiri ba “maatla” ba tsenatsena malwetši a batho le tokologo ya bahlokomedi ba bona ye e sego ya loka (ka go šitiša ditokologo tša bona tša motheo) le tokologo ye kaone (ka go ba thibela go kgatha tema ka lapeng la bona le maphelong a bona a setšhabeng).
Amharic: ጥናቱ የተካሄደው በቋንቋ እና በነፃነት ማዕቀፍ (ኦቤንግ 2018፣ 2020) ሲሆን ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት በሽታ እና “ኃያላን” ተዋናዮች በታመሙ ግለሰቦች እና ተንከባካቢዎች አሉታዊ ነፃነት (መሠረታዊ ነፃነታቸውን በመጣስ) እና አወንታዊ ነፃነት (በቤተሰባቸው እና በጋራ ህይወታቸው እንዳይሳተፉ በመከልከል) ውስጥ ጣልቃ በመግባት ነው።

English: Common linguistic strategies used in talking about disease and in seeking and protecting participants liberty include: silence, hesitations, reduplication, adjectives of quality, adverbs and intensifiers, verbs denoting physical sensation, and factive formulae (for evidentiality and credence).
Luganda: Olulimi olutera okukozesebwa mu kwogera ku ndwadde ne mu kufuna awamu n’okukuuma eddembe ly’abeetabi mulimu: okusirika, okulonzalonza, okuddamu ebigambo, okukozesa nnakongezalinnya ez’obungi, nnakongezakikolwa, obugambo obunyiinyiitiza, ebikolwa ebyoleka empulira y’omuntu, awamu ne fobukodyo nnamazima (olw’obukakafu n’obukkirizika).
Yoruba: Ilànà ìmọ̀ ẹ̀da èdè tó wọ́pọ̀ tí wọ́n ń lò láti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àrùn àti bíbèrè fún àti dídàbòbò òmìnira àwọn akópa ni: Ìdákẹ́jẹ́, ìṣiyèméjì, àpètúnpè, ọ̀rọ̀, àpèjúwe ohun àmúyẹ, ọ̀rọ̀ àpọ́nlé àti ọ̀rọ̀ àpọ́nlé tí a fí ń ṣe ìtẹnumọ́, ọ̀rọ̀ ìṣẹ tí ó ń tọ́ka sí àìníbàlẹ̀-ọkàn àfojúrí, àti àgbékalẹ̀ òótọ́ (fún ẹ̀rí àti ìgbàgbọ́).
Zulu: Amasu avamile olimi asetshenziswa ekukhulumeningezifo nasekufuneni nasekuvikeleni inkululeko yabahlanganyeli ahlanganisa: ukuthula, ukungabaza, ukuphindaphinda, izichasiso zeqophelo, izandiso neziqinisi, izenzo ezisho ukuzwa komzimba, kanye nefomula eyiqiniso (yobufakazi nokuqinisekisa).
Hausa: Dabarun harshe gama-gari da aka yi amfani da su wajen magana game da cuta da neman da kuma kare ‘yancin mahalarta sun haɗa da: shiru da jinkiri da maimaitawa da sifofin inganci da maganganu da ƙarfafawa da fi'ili da ke nuna ji na zahiri, da factiveformulae (don tabbatarwa da tabbaci).
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ye e tlwaelegilego ya polelo ye e šomišwago go bolela mabapi le bolwetši le go nyaka le go šireletša tokologo ya bakgathatema e akaretša: go homola, go dikadika, go bušeletša, mahlaodi ka ga boleng, mahlathi le ditiišetši, madiri ao a laetšago dikwi tša mmele, le difomula tša mabaka (go hwetša bohlatse le kamogelo ya bonnete).
Amharic: ስለ በሽታ ለመነጋገር እና የተሳታፊዎችን ነፃነት ለማግኘት እና ለመጠበቅ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውሉ የተለመዱ የቋንቋ ስልቶች የሚከተለቱን ያካትታሉ፦ ዝምታ፣ ማመንታት፣ ማባዛት፣ የጥራት መግለጫዎች፣ ተውላጠ ቃላቶች እና ማጠናከሪያዎች፣ አካላዊ ስሜትን የሚያመለክቱ ግሶች እና ተጨባጭ ቀመሮች (ለማስረጃ እና ታማኝነት)።

English: Discourse-pragmatic strategies for delivering bad news and for seeking liberty include the speech acts of complaining, blaming and assuring.
Luganda: Olulimi lw’okutuusa amawulire amabi awamu n’olwo olw’okufuna eddembe mulimu okwemulugunya, okunenya n’okukakasa omuntu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìlànà ìgbọ́ra-ẹni-yé fún jíjábọ̀ ìròyìn aburú àti fún wíwá òmìnira ni fífí ẹjọ́ sùn pẹ̀lú ìlànà ọ̀rọ̀ sísọ, dídáni lẹ́bi àti ìdánilójú.
Zulu: Amasu enkulumo-ephathekayo yokuletha izindaba ezimbi kanye nokufuna inkululeko ahlanganisa izenzo zenkulumo zokukhononda, ukusola nokuqinisekisa.
Hausa: Dabarun maganganu masu dacewa domin isar da mummunan labari da kuma neman 'yanci sun haɗa da ayyukan magana na gunaguni, zargi da tabbatarwa.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwatiragatšo ka ga poledišano ya go tliša ditaba tša maswabi le go nyaka tokologo e akaretša ditiro tša polelo tša go ngongorega, tša go sola le go netefatša.
Amharic: ንግግር-ተግባራዊ ስልቶች መጥፎ ዜናዎችን ለማድረስ እና ነፃነትን ለማግኘት የማጉረምረም፣ የመውቀስ እና የማረጋጋት የንግግር ድርጊቶችን ያካትታሉ።

English: Other strategies include avoidance, inferencing and polyvocality.
Luganda: Obukodyo obulala mulimu okwebalama, okukubira n’okukozesa amaloboozi amangi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìlànà mìíràn ni yíyàgò fún, gbígbé èrò titun jáde àti sísọ èrò tó yàtọ̀.
Zulu: Amanye amasu ahlanganisa ukugwema, ukugxeka kanye namazwi amaningi.
Hausa: Sauran dabarun sun haɗa da nisantar da kai ga ba da labari da kuma yawan magana.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ye mengwe e akaretša go efoga, go laetša le go tšweletša maikutlo a mantši.
Amharic: ሌሎች ስልቶች ደግሞ መራቅን፣ ማመላከትን እና ብዝሃ ድምጽን ያካትታሉ።

English: It is concluded that to protect diseased individuals’ liberty from and liberty to, there is the need to put in place rights that protect these freedoms and empower diseased individuals to participate in their family and communal lives.
Luganda: Okuwunzika kulaga nti okusobola okukuuma eddembe ly’abalwadde, waliwo obwetaavu bw’okuteekawo eddembe erikuuma eddembe lino era eriyamba abantu abalwadde okwetaba mu nsonga za famire zaabwe awamu n’ezo ez’omu bitundu byabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ti fẹnu kò wí pé láti dáábòbò àwọn aláìsàn òmìnira fún àti òmìnira sí, wọ́n ní láti àwọn ohun ẹ̀tọ́ tó ma dáábòbò òmìnira yìí tí ó má ran àwọn aláìsàn lọ́wọ́ láti kọ́pa nínú ẹbí àti gbígbé pẹ̀lú àwọn ènìyàn pọ̀.
Zulu: Kufinyelelwa esiphethweni sokuthi ukuze kuvikelwe inkululeko yabantu abagulayo evela kanye nenkululeko yabagulayo eya, kunesidingo sokubeka amalungelo avikela le nkululeko kanye nokunikeza abantu abagulayo amandla okuba bahlanganyele emindenini yabo nasezimpilweni zomphakathi.
Hausa: An kammala cewa domin kare ’yancin mutane marasa lafiya daga ’yanci da walwala, akwai buƙatar sanya haƙƙoƙin da ke kare waɗannan ‘yancin da ba wa mutane damar shiga cikin danginsu da kuma rayuwar jama’a.
Northern Sotho: Go phethwa ka gore go šireletša tokologo ya batho bao ba hlokofaletšwego go tokologo le go tšwa go yona, go na le tlhokego ya go hloma diokelo tše di šireletšago ditokologo tše le go maatlafatša batho bao ba hlokofaletšwego gore ba kgathe tema ka maphelong a ka malapeng a bona le a setšhabeng.

Amharic: በተለይም ልዩ ሁኔታቸውን ለመቋቋም ታማሚዎች እና ተንከባካቢዎች እንዴት እንደሚነጋገሩ ተንትነዋል።

English: Their results showed that when dealing with a disease, both the sick person and the caregiver were affected in that their freedom was taken away because they were not allowed to interact with other family members or the community.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti mu kulwanyisa endwadde, omulwadde n’omujjanjabi bombi baakosebwa mu ngeri nti eddembe lyabwe lyabaggyibwako kubanga tebakkirizibwa kunyumya na baŋŋanda balala oba abantu b’omu kitundu.
Yoruba: Èsì wọ́n fi hàn pé, tí wọ́n bá ń mójútó àrùn kan, aláìsàn àti olùṣètọ́jú yóò ní ìkóràn tí òmìnira yóò sì di gbígbá lọ́wọ́ wọn látàrí pé wọn kò ní ní ànfàní láti bá àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí tó kù sọ̀rọ̀ tàbí agbègbè ọ̀hún.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi uma bebhekene nesifo, ogulayo kanye nomnakekeli bathinteka ngoba bephucwa inkululeko ngoba bengavunyelwe ukuxhumana namanye amalungu omndeni noma nomphakathi.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa a lokacin da ake fama da wata cuta, majinyata da mai kula da lafiyarsu sun kamu da cutar ta yadda an ɗauke musu ’yancinsu domin an hana su mu’amala da sauran ’yan’uwa ko kuma jama’a.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore ge ba šoma ka bolwetši, bobedi motho yo a babjago le mohlokomedi wa gagwe ba a amega ka gore tokologo ya bona e tšerwe ka ge ba se ba dumelelwa go boledišana le maloko a mangwe a lapa goba le setšhaba.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው ታማሚውም ሆነ ተንከባካቢው ከበሽታ ጋር በሚገናኙበት ጊዜ ከሌሎች የቤተሰብ አባላትም ሆነ ከማህበረሰቡ ጋር እንዳይገናኙ በመደረጉ ነፃነታቸውን በመገፈፍ ታግደዋል።

English: The researchers said in most cases, when people (both the sick and caregiver) talked about bad news, they would sometimes keep silent, hesitate to talk, repeat sentences or use words that stressed what they said.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti mu mbeera ezisinga, abantu (omulwadde n’omujjanjabi) bwe baayogeranga ku mawulire amabi, oluusi baasirikanga, ne balonzalonza okwogera, ne baddamu emboozi oba ne bakozesa ebigambo ebyaggumizanga bye boogedde.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà, tí àwọn èyàn (àwọn aláìsàn àti olùṣètọ́jú) bá ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìròyìn aburú, nígbà mìíràn wọ́n ma dákẹ́jẹ, wọ́n ò ní fẹ́ sọ̀rọ̀, ṣàtúnsọ gbólóhùn náà tàbí lo ọ̀rọ̀ láti ṣe ìfàgùn ọ̀rọ̀ tí wọ́n sọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ezimweni eziningi, lapho abantu (bobabili ogulayo kanye nomnakekeli) bekhuluma ngezindaba ezimbi, ngezinye izikhathi babethula, bangabaze ukukhuluma, baphindaphinde imisho noma basebenzise amagama agcizelela lokho abakushoyo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce a mafi yawan lokuta, lokacin da mutane (da marasa lafiya da masu kula da su) suke magana game da munanan labarai, wani lokaci sukan yi shiru, suna jinkirin yin magana, maimaita jimloli ko amfani da kalmomin da suka jaddada abin da suka faɗa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore mabakeng a mantši, ge batho (bobedi molwetši le mohlokomedi) ba boledišana ka ga ditaba tša maswabi, ka dinako tše dingwe ba be ba homola, ba dikadika go bolela, ba bušeletša mafoko goba ba šomiša mantšu ao a gatelelago seo ba se boletšego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአብዛኛዎቹ ጉዳዮች ሰዎች (ሁለቱም የታመሙ እና ተንከባካቢዎች) መጥፎ ዜና ሲናገሩ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ዝም ይላሉ፣ ለመናገር ያመነታሉ፣ አረፍተ ነገሮችን ይደጋግማሉ ወይም የሚናገሩትን የሚያጎሉ ቃላት ይጠቀማሉ ብለዋል።

English: The researchers mentioned local language phrases that are commonly understood to emphasise meaning in a certain way.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baamenya ebituttwa ebiri mu nnimi ennansi ebimanyiddwa ennyo nti bikozesebwa okuggumiza ensonga mu ngeri emu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé èdè abínibí tí a má ń sábà ní àgbọ́yé rẹ̀ láti ṣe ìtẹnumọ́ ìtumọ ní àwọn ọ̀nà kan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakhulume imishwana yolimi lwendawo evame ukuqondwa ukuze bagcizelele incazelo ngendlela ethile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ambaci yankunan jumlar harshen gida waɗanda aka fi fahimta domin jaddada ma'ana ta wata hanya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše mafokwana a polelo ya gae ao ka tlwaelo a kwešišegago go gatelela tlhalošo ka tsela ye itšego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተወሰነ መንገድ ትርጉሙን ለማጉላት በተለምዶ የሚወሰዱትን የሃገር በቀል ቋንቋ ሃረጎች ጠቅሰዋል።

English: Sometimes people would appear to complain or blame others.
Luganda: Oluusi abantu baalabikanga okuba nga beemulugunya oba nga banenya abalala.
Yoruba: Nígbà mìíràn àwọn ma wá láti fẹjọ́ sùn tàbí dá àwọn tí ó kùn lẹ́bi.
Zulu: Ngezinye izikhathi abantu babebonakala bekhononda noma besola abanye.
Hausa: Wani lokaci mutane za su bayyana suna yin gunaguni ko zargin wasu.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinako tše dingwe batho ba tla bonala ba ngongorega goba ba sola ba bangwe.
Amharic: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ሰዎች ሌሎችን የሚያማርሩ ወይም የሚወቅሱ ይመስላሉ።

English: They blamed witches or jealous relatives for the sickness.
Luganda: Baanenya abalogo oba abeŋŋanda ababafitina olw’endwadde ze balina.
Yoruba: Wọ́n má ń dá àwọn àjẹ́ tàbí àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí òjòwú lẹ́bi fún àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Basola abathakathi noma izihlobo ezinomona ngokugula.
Hausa: Sun zargi mayu ko ’yan’uwa masu kishi da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba sola baloi goba ba leloko bao ba nago le mona bjalo ka seo se bakilego bolwetši.
Amharic: ለበሽታው ጠንቋዮችን ወይም ቀናተኛ ዘመዶችን ወቅሰዋል።

English: They also avoided talking, or expressed different viewpoints all in the same conversation, such that there would be no conclusion.
Luganda: Beewala n’okwogera, oba ne booleka endowooza ez’enjawulo mu mboozi y’emu, waleme kubaawo kuwunzika kutuukibwako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún kọ̀ láti sọ̀rọ̀, tàbí fi àbá tó yàtọ̀ sílẹ̀ nípa ọ̀rọ̀ náà, tí ìkádìí kankan ò ní fi sí.
Zulu: Babekugwema nokukhuluma, noma baveze imibono ehlukene engxoxweni efanayo, ukuze kungabikho isiphetho.
Hausa: Sun kuma guje wa yin magana, ko kuma bayyana ra’ayoyi daban-daban duk a cikin zance ɗaya, ta yadda ba za a samu ƙarshe ba.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba ile ba efoga go bolela, goba ba hlagiša maikutlo ao a fapafapanego ka moka ka poledišanong yona yeo, fao e lego gore ga go be le mafetšo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ከመነጋገር ተቆጥበዋል ወይም በአንድ ንግግር ውስጥ መደምደሚያ እንዳይኖር የተለያዩ አመለካከቶችን ይገልፁ ነበር።

English: The researchers reported that when people talked about bad news they paused often, hesitating or staying silent as they tried to hold back the bad news.
Luganda: Abanoonereza baagamba nti abantu bwe baayogeranga ku mawulire amabi, ebiseera ebisinga baasikattiranga, okulonzalonza okwogera oba okusirika nga bagezaako okumira amawulire amabi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fi léde pé nígbà tí àwọn ènìyàn bá ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìròyìn aburú wọ́ má ń sábà ṣẹ́nukù, tàbí kí wọ́n dákẹ́ láti lè gbìyànjú láti pa ìròyì aburú náà mọ́ra.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi lapho abantu bekhuluma ngezindaba ezimbi babema kaningi, bengabaza noma bathule njengoba bezama ukubamba izindaba ezimbi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton cewa lokacin da mutane suke magana game da munanan labarai suna ɗan tsayawa sau da yawa, suna shakka ko yin shiru yayin da suke ƙoƙarin hana bayar da mugun labari.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore ge batho ba bolela ka ga ditaba tša maswabi ba fela gantši ba emanyana go bolela, ba dikadika goba ba homola ge ba leka go širetša ditaba tša maswabi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሰዎች ስለ መጥፎ ዜና ሲናጋገሩ ብዙውን ጊዜ ለአፍታ ቆም ብለው ያመነታሉ ወይም መጥፎ ዜናውን አምቆ ለመያዝ በመሞከር በዝምታ ይቆያሉ ብለው ዘግበዋል።

English: They said the pauses were longer (5 seconds) than normal (0.5 seconds).
Luganda: Baagamba nti okusikattira kwali kuwanvu (obutikitiki 5) okusinga okwa bulijjo (obutikitiki 0.5).
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ìṣẹ́nukù náà jẹ́ èyí tí ó gùn (ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5) jú èyí tó wà nílẹ̀ lọ ( ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 0.5).
Zulu: Bathe ukuphumula kube kude (imizuzwana emi-5) kunokujwayelekile (imizuzwana engu-0.5).
Hausa: Sun ce ‘yan tsayawar sun fi tsayi (daƙiƙa 5) fiye da na al’ada (daƙiƙoƙo 0.5).
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore go emanyana ga bona ge ba sa bolele go bile go gotelele (metsotswana ye 5) go feta ka fao go tlwaelegilego (metsotswana ye 0.5).
Amharic: የአፍታ ቆይታዎቻቸው ከተለመደው (0.5 ሰከንድ) በላይ ረዘም ያሉ (5 ሰከንድ) ነበሩ ብለዋል።

English: The pauses were sometimes meant to show frustration or anger.
Luganda: Okusikattira oluusi kwalaganga okusoberwa oba obusungu.
Yoruba: Nígbà mìíràn ìṣẹ́nukù ló má ń ṣàfihàn ìkanra àti ìbínú.
Zulu: Ukuphumula ngezinye izikhathi kwakuhloselwe ukukhombisa ukukhungatheka noma intukuthelo.
Hausa: ‘Yan tsayawar wani lokaci ana nufin nuna takaici ne ko fushi.
Northern Sotho: Go emanyana go bolela fa ka dinako tše dingwe go be go era go laetša kgakanego goba go befela.
Amharic: የአፍት ቆይታዎቹ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ብስጭት ወይም ቁጣን ለማሳየት አልመዋል።

English: The researchers also said they noted that the sick person or caregiver was not allowed to talk about the cause of the disease they were dealing with.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti omulwadde oba omujjanjabi yali takkirizibwa kwogera ku kyaviirako ndwadde gye baali balwanyisa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tún ṣàkíyèsí pé wọ́n ò gba àwọn aláìsàn tàbí olùṣètọ́jú láàyè láti sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ohun tó fa àrùn tí wọ́n mójútó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi bakuqaphelile ukuthi ogulayo noma umnakekeli akavumelekile ukukhuluma ngembangela yesifo ababhekene naso.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ce sun lura cewa ba a ba wa marar lafiya ko mai kulawa ba damar yin magana game da musabbabin cutar da suke fama da ita ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gape gore ba lemogile gore motho yo a babjago goba mohlokomedi o be a se a dumelelwa go bolela ka ga seo se bakilego bolwetši bjo ba bego ba lebane le bjona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ታማሚው ወይም ተንከባካቢው ስላጋጠማቸው በሽታ መንስኤ እንዳይነጋገሩ መከልከላቸውንም ጠቁመዋል።

English: This was because it might cause tension in the community, because sometimes disease or death were thought to be caused by jealous relatives.
Luganda: Kyali kityo kubanga kiyinza okuleetawo obunkenke mu kitundu, kubanga oluusi endwadde oba okufa byalowoozebwa okuba nga bivudde ku beŋŋanda abalina ffitina.
Yoruba: Èyí wáyé nítorí pé ó lè fa ìbẹ̀rùbojo nínú ìlú, nítorí nígbà mìíràn wọ́n rò pé àwọn mọ̀lẹ́bí òjòwú ló ń fa ikú tàbí àrùn.
Zulu: Lokhu kwakungenxa yokuthi kungase kubange ukungezwani emphakathini, ngoba ngezinye izikhathi izifo noma ukufa kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kubangelwa izihlobo ezinomona.
Hausa: Hakan ya faru ne domin yana iya haifar da tashin hankali a cikin al’umma, domin a wasu lokuta ana tunanin cututtuka ko mutuwa daga ’yan’uwa masu kishi ne.
Northern Sotho: Se e be e le ka lebaka la gopre se be se ka baka thulano setšhabeng, ka gobane ka dinako tše dingwe bolwetši goba lehu di be di naganwa gore di bakilwe ke ba leloko bao ba nago le mona.
Amharic: ይህ የሚሆንበት ምክንያት በማህበረሰቡ ውስጥ ውጥረት ሊፈጥር ስለሚችል ነው፤ ምክንያቱም አንዳንድ ጊዜ በሽታ ወይም ሞት በቀናተኛ ዘመዶች ይከሰታሉ ተብሎ ስለሚታመን ነው።

English: People also thought not naming anyone maintained peace.
Luganda: Abantu era baalowooza nti obutaasanguza muntu yenna kyakuumanga emirembe.
Yoruba: Àwọn èyàn tún rò pé àì má fún ẹnikẹ́ni lórúkọ lé jẹ́ kí ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ wà.
Zulu: Abantu baphinde bacabanga ukungaqambi muntu kugcina ukuthula.
Hausa: Mutane kuma sun yi tunanin rashin bayyana sunan kowa ya tabbatar da zaman lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Batho gape ba ile ba nagana go se bolele leina la motho yo mongwe gore go tšwele pele go be le khutšo.
Amharic: ሰዎች የማንንም ስም አለመጥቀስ ሰላም ያስከብራል ብለው ያስባሉ።

English: The news bearer often resorted to not drawing any conclusions and not mentioning anyone.
Luganda: Ebiseera ebisinga omuwamawulire yasalawo obutabaako kukubira kwonna kw’akola awamu n’obutamenya muntu yenna.
Yoruba: Ẹni tó ń ṣe agbátẹrù ìròyìn kìí sábà mú ọ̀rọ̀ wá sí ìparí àti wí pé wọn kìí sọ́ ẹnìkankan.
Zulu: Umphathi wezindaba ubevame ukusebenzisa ukungafinyeleli esiphethweni futhi angasho muntu.
Hausa: Mai watsa labaran ya sha yin amfani da shi don kada ya yanke shawara kuma bai ambaci kowa ba.
Northern Sotho: Bao ba hweditšego ditaba tše gantši ba be ba feleletša ba etla ka diphetho dife goba dife gomme ba sa bolele leina la motho yo mongwe.
Amharic: የዜናው አቀባይ ብዙ ጊዜ ምንም መደምደሚያ ላይ ላለመድረስ እና ማንንም ላለመጥቀስ ይሞክር ነበር።

English: The researchers noticed that caretakers wanted to be at peace and to not offend the sick person, and that way their task of caring for them would be easier.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakiraba ng’abajjanjabi baali baagala kubeera mu mirembe sso si kunyiiza mulwadde, era nga mu ngeri eyo, okubajjanjaba kuba kujja kuba kwangu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàkíyèsí pé àwọn aṣètọ́jú fẹ́ ní ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ àti láti má dánúbí àwọn aláìsàn, ní ọ̀nà bẹ́ẹ̀ iṣẹ́ wọ́n nípa ṣíṣé ìtọ́jú yóò rọrùn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqaphela ukuthi abanakekeli babefuna ukuba nokuthula futhi bangamcasuli umuntu ogulayo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela umsebenzi wabo wokubanakekela wawuyoba lula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura cewa masu kulawa suna son su kasance cikin kwanciyar hankali kuma kada su ɓata wa mara lafiya rai, kuma ta haka ne aikinsu na kula da su zai kasance da sauƙi.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore bahlokomedi ba balwetši ba be ba nyaka go ba le khutšo le gore ba se ke ba roga molwetši, gomme ka tsela ye mošomo wa bona wa go ba hlkokomela o ka ba bonolo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ተንከባካቢዎች ሰላም እንዲሆኑ እና የታመመውን ሰው ላለማስቀየም እንደሚፈልጉ እናም በዚህ መንገድ እነሱን የመንከባከብ ስራቸው ቀላል እንደሚሆን አስተውለዋል።

English: The researchers recommended that rights of sick people should be promoted.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa nti eddembe ly’abalwadde lisaanye litumbulwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí dábàá pé ẹ̀tọ́ àwọn aláìsàn ní láti ní ìlọsíwájú.
Zulu: Abacwaningi batusa ukuthi amalungelo abantu abagulayo kufanele akhuthazwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata a inganta haƙƙin marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore ditokelo tša balwetši di swanetše go tšwetšwa pele.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የታመሙ ሰዎችን መብት ማሳደግ እንዳለባቸው መክረዋል።

English: They also recommended training for caregivers so that they know how to communicate well with other people, including the sick person.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baateesa wabeewo okutendeka abajjanjabi basobole okumanya engeri y’okuwuliziganyaamu n’abantu abalala, nga n’omulwadde kw’omutadde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún dábàá pé wọ́n ní láti kọ́ àwọn olùṣètọ́jú kí wọ́n ba lè mọ bí wọ́n ṣe lè bá àwọn ẹlòmíràn sọ̀rọ̀ tó fí mọ àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Baphinde batusa ukuqeqeshwa kwabanakekeli ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabanye abantu, kufaka nomuntu ogulayo.
Hausa: Sun kuma bayar da shawarar horar da masu kulawa domin su san yadda za su iya sadarwa da kyau da sauran mutane, ciki har da mara lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba šišintše gore bahlokomedi ba balwetši ba hlahlwe gore ba kgone go tseba ka fao ba ka boledišanago gabotse le batho ba bangwe, go akaretšwa le go boledišana le molwetši.
Amharic: እንዲሁም የታመመውን ሰው ጨምሮ ከሌሎች ሰዎች ጋር እንዴት መግባባት እንደሚችሉ እንዲያውቁ ለተንከባካቢዎች ስልጠና እንዲሰጡ መክረዋል።

English: Researchers from a university in the USA did the study in Ghana.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okuva mu yunivaasite ey’omu USA baakola okunoonyereza kuno mu ggwanga lya Ghana.
Yoruba: Aṣèwádìí láti ilẹ́ ẹ̀kọ́ gíga kan ni USA ló ṣe ìwádìí yìí ní Ghana.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basenyuvesi yase-USA benza ucwaningo eGhana.
Hausa: Masu bincike daga wata jami'a a ƙasar Amurka ne suka gudanar da binciken a ƙasar Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši go tšwa ka yunibesithing ka USA ba dirile dinyakišišo tše ka Ghana.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በጋና የተደረገው በአሜሪካ ከሚገኝ ዪኒቨርሲቲ በመጡ ተመራማሪዎች ነው ።
